universal_guidelines: NEVER use default Tailwind colors (slate-500, blue-600) directly. Use CSS variables or the custom palette defined above.
Dark mode is the DEFAULT and PRIMARY mode. Light mode is secondary.
Use 'Outfit' for all headings (h1-h3) and 'Manrope' for body text and numbers.
All interactive elements must have a hover state (brightness-110 or subtle scale).
Use 1px borders with very low opacity (white/10) instead of heavy shadows for depth.
Charts must use the defined color palette and be accessible (high contrast).
Input fields should look like 'glass' - semi-transparent background with subtle border.
Do not use generic 'Lorem Ipsum'. Use realistic financial data and copy.
Ensure all images have alt text for accessibility.
Use 'lucide-react' for icons, with a stroke width of 1.5px for a refined look.
instructions_to_main_agent: You are building CIMA VE. Start by setting up the global theme in globals.css based on the 'colors' section. Then, install 'Outfit' and 'Manrope' fonts using @fontsource or Google Fonts. Build the layouts using the 'Bento' grid strategy. Use the provided image URLs for the specific sections. Prioritize the 'Dashboard' and 'Marketing' pages. Ensure the 'Cima Pulse' and 'Collections' features are visually distinct.
